P_0x00EEB5: Marshal of the <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist, sees the big picture, accepts good and ill. Dry, but loves sake and grandkids.
P_0x00EF62: Chairman of <Earth Fed Army> Joint Chiefs, ranked General. Gaspard's right-hand man. Cautious, bureaucratic - clashed with pragmatic Norman Sley, founder of Earth Sphere Defense Committee.
P_0x00F084: Director of Intelligence, <Earth Fed Army>, lieutenant general. Gilliam Yager's superior, ex-elite agent, sharp, tied to politics/business. Gilliam trusts him fully; he values Gilliam's skill. Courts women with style. Widowed once.
P_0x00F25B: Upper house member, <Earth Fed Gov't> parliament. Aqua Centrum's father. Serious, doting, worries constantly about Aqua, who ran off to join the military.
P_0x00F33D: Member of <Earth Fed Army>'s 3rd Special Ops <PT> unit "Cry Wolves." Son of captain Albero Est. Easygoing, especially close with Hugo.
U_0x00674D:
A "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - ancient semi-living weapons built to fight the "Hyakuja" demons. Forms when JakuOhKi (Suzaku) merges with BuOhKi (Genbu).
Its back-shell and Shinju Shield give it the Four Gods' best defense, and its Sofu (the talismans forming a <Chokijin>'s body) self-repair better than any other. It also carries Sofu parts from a special humanoid weapon, incl. modern missile launchers. Its main arm, the Black Serpent Mortar (from JakuBuOh's sword), suits bombardment and can become the long-range Genten Shoutenhou. Mobility is low, melee weak. BuJakuOh is calm, quiet, patient.
U_0x006CB2: A Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Genbu. High defense, low mobility; meant to shield other units, fights poorly alone.
U_0x014A35: Humanoid ground/artillery mobile weapon, aka Type 30. Slow, heavily armored, stable and reliable; can hover for great rough-terrain mobility. The Randgrith Raven adds a <Tesla Drive> booster pod and twin linear cannons for more firepower.
